name: Battle Tested
controllingIdea: In competitive markets, preparation and strategy beat panic and impulse.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: An intensely competitive scenario - bidding war, multiple offers, tough negotiation
narrativeArc.risingAction: Tactics deployed, tension builds, competitors emerge
narrativeArc.crisis: The deciding moment - what strategy wins?
narrativeArc.climax: Strategy pays off - the win is secured
narrativeArc.resolution: Wisdom for future battles - what can others learn?

questions.question: What was the competitive situation your client faced?
questions.placeholder: There were 15 offers on the table, including several all-cash...

questions.question: What tactics or strategies did you deploy?
questions.placeholder: We wrote an escalation clause, shortened inspection period, and...

questions.question: What was the deciding factor that secured the win?
questions.placeholder: The seller valued the personal letter more than the highest offer...

questions.question: What would you tell other buyers facing similar competition?
questions.placeholder: It's not always about being the highest. It's about understanding what the seller values...

promptConfig.systemContext: This is a strategic victory story. The agent demonstrates competitive expertise. Focus on the tactics and thinking that led to success.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Strategic, confident, but not cocky. This is about smart preparation, not luck. Share wisdom others can use.

usageHints: Focus on 2-3 specific tactics, not everything
Make the lesson applicable to others
Show strategic thinking, not just luck

exampleScenarios.title: 15 Offers, One Winner
exampleScenarios.situation: Buyers won against 14 other offers through smart strategy
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: My buyers were up against 14 other offers including 5 all-cash. We won with an escalation clause up to $20k over asking, flexible closing date, and a personal letter. Turned out the seller's son went to the same school as my client.

expectedOutput.hook: 15 offers. 5 all-cash. We won. Here's how.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: Sometimes it's not the highest offer. It's the right connection.
